title: Web widget
description: The live chat bubble you add to your site with one line of code. Each widget works as a separate channel.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view widget settings. Ask your organization admin for access.
empty_hint: Type a name on the left to create your first widget.
confirm_delete: Delete this widget? The bubble on your site stops working; conversations are kept.
error.title: Could not load widgets
error.description: Refresh the page and try again.
fields.name: Name
fields.prechat_hint: The chosen request form is asked before the first message; its fields are defined on the form.
fields.file_upload_hint: Visitors can attach files and images (up to 10 MB).
fields.csat_hint: Visitors rate resolved conversations from 1 to 5.
fields.hours_hint: Outside hours the widget shows offline and requires an email.
fields.domains_hint: One domain per line. *.example.com covers every subdomain. Empty means any site may use it.
fields.identity_secret_hint: Your server computes user_hash = HMAC-SHA256(secret, user ID) to verify signed-in users.
fields.identity_secret_once: This secret is shown only now. Copy it to your server before saving.
fields.identity_secret_none: No secret: only anonymous visitors can chat.
fields.require_identity_hint: Anonymous visitors cannot send messages (for sites behind a login, like a customer portal).
install.snippet_hint: Add this line before the </body> tag on every page of your site.
toast.failed: Could not complete the action. Try again.
preview.label: Preview
replay.intro: Masked session replay and co-browse for this widget. Both start off; visitors always see a consent prompt and can stop at any time. Text and input values are masked and never leave the browser unmasked.
replay.replay_enabled_hint: Visitors can share a masked recording of their session after consenting.
replay.cobrowse_enabled_hint: Agents can ask to watch the visitor's page live; nothing is stored.
replay.control_enabled_hint: With extra consent, agents can click buttons your site marks with data-clickfix-control. No typing or navigation.
replay.retention_hint: Recordings are deleted after 1–30 days. Your plan may allow less.
replay.block_selectors_hint: One CSS selector per line (up to 20). Matching elements are never captured. Inputs, media and [data-private] are always blocked.
replay.selector_limit: You can add at most {{count}} selectors.
replay.plan_note: Your plan must include session replay or co-browse; otherwise visitors are not offered them.
channel.chat_hint: Visitors can start conversations in the widget.
channel.callback_hint: Visitors leave their number and you call them; the request arrives as a conversation.
channel.video_hint: Visitors ask for a video call; start it from the conversation.
editor.discard_confirm: Discard the unpublished changes and go back to the live version?
editor.issues: {{count}} setting(s) need fixing before you can publish.
editor.publish_hint: Visitors see the new settings right away as version v{{version}}. You can roll back at any time.
f.ai_enabled: AI agent answers in this widget
f.ai_enabled_hint: Uses the organization's AI agent settings (mode, hours, knowledge). Off: only people answer.
f.ai_human_hint: Shown under AI answers; the AI agent hands the conversation over at once.
f.attribute_target_hint: name, email, phone or custom:<custom field key>
f.away_mode_hint: Shows the team as away even inside business hours.
f.collect_email: Ask for an e-mail address outside business hours
f.consent_gate: Ask for consent before the widget stores anything
f.consent_gate_hint: Until the visitor agrees nothing is written to the browser. Your consent manager can also call ClickFix('consent', true).
f.cookieless_hint: Keeps the visitor session in memory only; a page reload starts a new visitor.
f.countries_hint: Uses the visitor's IP country (Cloudflare header or GeoIP database on the server).
f.custom_css_hint: Applies inside the widget only (Shadow DOM). @import, scripts and non-https URLs are removed.
f.custom_launcher_hint: Using your own button? Hide the launcher with ClickFix('hideLauncher') and add data-clickfix-launcher to your button.
f.exit_intent_hint: When the mouse leaves the page towards the tabs (desktop).
f.fullscreen_hint: The panel fills the screen below 480 px width.
f.handoff_keywords_hint: A visitor message with one of these words goes straight to the team.
f.hide_on_hint: Any matching rule hides the widget.
f.launcher_label_hint: Optional text next to the icon (e.g. "Help").
f.locale_hint: Automatic picks the visitor's browser language (Turkish or English).
f.logo_url_hint: An https image shown in the header instead of the team avatars.
f.persistence_hint: Where the visitor session is kept in the browser.
f.rate_limit_hint: Protects your team from floods; 30 suits most sites.
f.show_team_hint: Team members' avatars or initials show in the header.
f.theme_hint: Automatic follows the visitor's system setting.
f.trigger_open_hint: Off: a small bubble above the launcher.
f.url_rules_hint: "/pricing" matches the path; a full https:// address matches the whole URL. * is a wildcard in "pattern".
g.ai_hint: Decide whether the AI agent answers visitors of this widget and when it hands over.
g.attributes_hint: Optional aliases: connect an SDK attribute that arrives under another name (setAttributes, identify, pre-chat answers) to a contact field or to name/e-mail/phone. Attributes sent with a contact field's key need no mapping.
g.channels_hint: Other ways to reach you, shown on the home screen.
g.colors_hint: Text colors are picked automatically for contrast.
g.consent_hint: A checkbox before the first message; the consent is kept on the message.
g.home_cards_hint: Cards in the order visitors see them. Help center cards show only when you have a public help center.
g.offline_hint: What visitors see outside business hours or while you are away.
g.pages_hint: Single-page apps are followed too: the widget re-checks on every navigation.
g.prechat_fields_hint: Asked before the first message; answers are kept on the message and can fill contact fields.
g.prechat_hint: The pre-chat form is a request form (Settings > Request forms). The widget only picks which one to show; known visitors skip what you already know.
g.privacy_hint: Cookie and storage behaviour for GDPR and KVKK.
g.quick_replies_hint: Chips above the composer of a new conversation; a click sends it.
g.reply_time_hint: Automatic uses your median first response of the last 14 days and the business hours.
g.texts_hint: Empty fields use the default text of that language.
g.triggers_hint: Greet visitors at the right moment. All conditions of a message must hold.
g.url_tester_hint: Check whether the widget and which proactive messages would show on an address.
history.description: Every publish is a version. Preview one or publish it again.
history.rollback_confirm: Publish v{{version}} again as the live version?
history.title: Version history
install.check_hint: Sites where the widget loaded recently (refreshed at most every 5 minutes).
install.not_seen: Not seen on any site yet. Add the code and open your site once.
issue.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
issue.contrast: Low contrast: text on this color is hard to read.
issue.contrast_bg: The color hardly stands out from the panel background.
issue.identity: Cookie-less mode forgets identified users on every page load.
tester.visible: The widget shows on this page.
tester.hidden_not_listed_page: Hidden: not in the "show only on" list.
toast.conflict: Someone published a newer version. The editor reloaded it.
feature.emoji_hint: An emoji button in the composer.
feature.typing_hint: Both sides see when the other is typing.
feature.read_receipts_hint: Visitors see when their message was seen.
feature.sound_hint: A soft sound for new replies while the page is in the background.
feature.notifications_hint: Asks permission after the visitor's first message.
feature.markdown_hint: Bold, italic, lists, code and links in messages.
platform_hint.html: Paste once before </body> on every page.
platform_hint.nextjs: Load it from the root layout with next/script.
platform_hint.react: Typed hooks from @clickfix/react-widget; useClickFix loads and boots the widget.
platform_hint.vue: Load the script once from your root component.
platform_hint.wordpress: Add to your (child) theme's functions.php or a code snippets plugin.
platform_hint.shopify: Add to layout/theme.liquid; signed-in customers are passed on.
platform_hint.gtm: A Custom HTML tag that fires on All Pages.
platform_hint.identify: Call after your user signs in; compute user_hash on your server.
section_hint.appearance: Colors, theme, font and shape of the panel.
section_hint.launcher: The button visitors click to open the chat.
section_hint.texts: Greeting and other texts in Turkish and English.
section_hint.home: What visitors see first when they open the widget.
section_hint.prechat: The request form and consent box shown before the first message.
section_hint.conversation: Features, files, satisfaction survey and offline behaviour.
section_hint.channels: WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, e-mail, phone, call back and video.
section_hint.ai: AI answers and handoff to your team.
section_hint.triggers: Messages that greet visitors by page, time, scroll or exit intent.
section_hint.targeting: Where and for whom the widget loads.
section_hint.hours: When the team shows as online.
section_hint.replay: Masked recordings and co-browse with consent.
section_hint.install: Add the widget to your site and check it is running.
text_default.tr.team_intro: Ekibimiz size yardım etmek için burada.
text_default.tr.offline_message: Şu an çevrimdışıyız. Mesajınızı bırakın, e-postayla dönelim.
text_default.tr.away_message: Şu an uzaktayız. Mesajınızı bırakın, en kısa sürede dönelim.
text_default.en.team_intro: Our team is here to help.
text_default.en.offline_message: We're offline right now. Leave a message and we'll reply by e-mail.
text_default.en.away_message: We're away right now. Leave a message and we'll get back to you soon.
theme.label: Theme
identity_warning.disabled_title: An identity verification attempt was rejected
identity_warning.disabled_body: Your site called identify, but this widget has no identity secret yet (403 WIDGET_IDENTITY_DISABLED). Your signed-in users stay anonymous. Generate the secret in the Security section and compute user_hash with it on your server.
identity_warning.invalid_title: The identity signature did not match
identity_warning.invalid_body: The user_hash of the last identify call did not match user_id (401 WIDGET_IDENTITY_INVALID). Check that your server uses this widget's current secret and signs the user_id. If you rotated the secret, update it on your server too.
identity_warning.clears: This warning clears on the first verification with a valid user_hash.
g.attributes_publish_notice: Custom fields apply as soon as they are defined and the widget accepts them by key. The aliases here are part of the widget settings: visitors get them only after you publish.
text.greeting_variables_hint: You can use variables in the greeting: the visitor's name (contact.first_name) and the custom fields the AI may read are filled with the visitor's values; list fields show the option label and sensitive fields stay empty. Click a variable below to copy it.
g.hours_source: The widget's online/offline state follows the organization's working hours; there are no separate hours here.
f.prechat_form_hint: Left empty, the first active form on the widget channel is used.
f.prechat_form_auto: Automatic (first active form on the widget channel)
f.prechat_form_none: No active request form offers the widget channel; visitors only see the message box.
basic.hint.appearance: Color, theme and launcher. Pick a look that matches your site.
basic.hint.identity: Language, greeting texts, logo and team. Let visitors see who they are talking to.
basic.hint.channel: AI assistant, pre-chat form, allowed domains and the install snippet.
basic.footnote: Everything you change here updates the same field in the advanced settings; the remaining 60+ settings live there.
